title: Computational assessment of oral contraceptive forgiveness: model and analysis pipeline
description: R implementation of an integrated population-pharmacokinetic and quantitative systems pharmacology model of the hypothalamic-pituitary-ovarian axis, used to quantify the missed-dose tolerance (forgiveness) of five oral contraceptive formulations across pack positions, CYP3A4 status and body weight. Includes the full Monte-Carlo pipeline, the validation and sensitivity analyses, and every result table reported in the accompanying paper.
